decisions.name: process
decisions.driver: precision H7 bore and accurate bolt circle require machining; bronze bushings are typically CNC turned/milled from bar or cast stock
decisions.provenance: resolve_process request=flanged bushing precision sliding-fit bronze → cnc_mill conf=0.95
decisions.rationale: precision H7 bore and accurate bolt circle require machining; bronze bushings are typically CNC turned/milled from bar or cast stock

decisions.basis: immaterial ambiguity — mission/ledger omit flange thickness; 5 mm is standard for M4 flanged bronze bushings (supports fastener head, ≥1.5 mm wall, CNC-friendly)

decisions.value: 20 mm overall length (flange 5 mm + hub extension 15 mm)
